تلتهمون (form VIII)
# تَلْتَهِمُونَ (taltahimūna) /tal.ta.hi.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
# تُلْتَهَمُونَ (tultahamūna) /tul.ta.ha.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
